cards.name: Otter Centurion
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Slick armor plates lashed from birch bark — first through the gate, first to slide back out.

cards.name: Ent
cards.where: Win The Old Bramble in The Old Bramble (Conquest)
cards.fl: A walking watchtower of oak and moss. Takes its time. The enemy usually doesn’t.

cards.name: Dolphin Knight
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Rides the moat like open water. Lance first, questions never.

cards.name: Bee Knight
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Small, shiny, and extremely offended by trespassers.

cards.name: Bee Drone
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Struck once, and a swarmling boils out immediately to keep the line held.

cards.name: Caustic Scorpion
cards.where: Win Scorpion Flats in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Wooden tank tread bolted to a scorpion’s tail. The sting lingers long after the tread stops.

cards.name: Yeti
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Less a warrior, more a siege engine that occasionally roars. Give it five turns to get moving.

cards.name: Scraper of Skies
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A hive-tower lashed together from ladders, rope and prayer. Once it's built, strike it and it answers with bees.

cards.name: Bee Swarmling
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Not drafted, not bought — just spilled out of something bigger when it was struck.

cards.name: Forager Ant
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Carries three times its body weight in acorns, and slightly more in grudges.

cards.name: Soldier Ant
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Mandibles built for one purpose. It has never once used them for anything else.

cards.name: Ant Warrior
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A worker who picked up a twig one day and never put it down.

cards.name: Ant Hill
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A city of tunnels dressed as a hill, taxing every passing beetle for the war effort.

cards.name: Otter Scout
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Whiskers first, pockets second. Always comes back from the riverbank with something shiny.

cards.name: Otter Shieldback
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Carries a driftwood shield strapped to its back. Slides into position, then doesn’t move.

cards.name: Owl Fletcher
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Feathers cut for silence, arrows cut for the same.

cards.name: Owl Sentinel
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Turns its head all the way around so nothing behind the line goes unwatched.

cards.name: Great Horned Owl
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Talons like grappling hooks. The moment it wakes, something in the enemy line already regrets it.

cards.name: Terrier Pup
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Too small to be scary. Nobody told it that.

cards.name: War Hound
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Strapped into leather barding before it could properly walk. Hasn’t stopped since.

cards.name: Armored Mastiff
cards.where: Win The Kennels in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Built like a battering ram with slightly better manners.

cards.name: Alley Cat
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Nine lives, and it’s spending every one of them recklessly.

cards.name: Bramblewood Lynx
cards.where: Win Cub Clearing in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Tufted ears, silent paws, and absolutely no patience for a slow fight.

cards.name: War Panther
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Camouflage stripes that were never really necessary — it’s simply faster than being seen.

cards.name: Bramblewood Macaque
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Steals rations, steals weapons, occasionally wins the fight anyway.

cards.name: Silverback Brawler
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Doesn’t so much fight a line as flatten the whole thing at once.

cards.name: Trapdoor Spider
cards.where: Win Web Hollow in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Waits under a hinged lid of moss and silk. The wait is the whole strategy.

cards.name: Webspire Sentinel
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A watchtower spun from silver silk. Nothing crosses its threads unnoticed — or alone.

cards.name: Compost Grub
cards.where: Win Spore Drift in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Slow, squishy, and somehow always still standing at the end of the round.

cards.name: Tunnel Wyrm
cards.where: Win Grub Tunnels in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Surfaces exactly where the enemy line least expects a worm.

cards.name: Gorge Wyrm
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A worm the size of a siege engine, because someone fed it entirely too well.

cards.name: Cricket Drummer
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Its chirp is the marching cadence for half the Bramblewood infantry.

cards.name: Carrion Fly Swarm
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Small, numerous, and deeply unpleasant to be surrounded by.

cards.name: Monarch Wingblade
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Wings edged in something sharper than pollen, and toxic besides.

cards.name: Bramble Sprout
cards.where: Win Moonlit Gills in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Barely a seedling. Somehow already armed.

cards.name: Thornvine Lasher
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Grows a foot a minute when there’s something worth wrapping around.

cards.name: Fungal Colossus
cards.where: Win The Morel Monarch in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: A mushroom the size of a shed. When it finally topples, spores take root where it fell.

cards.name: Elder Willow
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Roots older than the castle it now leans protectively over, and just as slow to give anything up.

cards.name: Ember Wisp
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Barely more than a floating spark, and everything standing next to it gets singed.

cards.name: Tide Spirit
cards.where: Win Kelp Curtains in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Formless, patient, and impossible to properly hit.

cards.name: Stoneheart Golem
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Assembled from castle rubble and something that might be actual magic. Nothing soaks in.

cards.name: Gale Sprite
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: You hear it before you see it. Mostly you just hear it.

cards.name: Stormcaller
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Calls down exactly one bolt the moment it wakes. It is never a wasted one.

cards.name: Minnow Skitter
cards.where: Win Lily Hop in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: Nearly weightless. Nearly worthless. Somehow still shows up to every fight.

cards.name: Pike Lancer
cards.where: Win Pike Shallows in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: A living spear with fins. Subtlety was never the plan.

cards.name: Pufferfish Bulwark
cards.where: Win Moray Den in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Doubles in size the moment anything gets close. Its own toxins never touch it.

cards.name: Reef Shark
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Circles the battlefield once, then bites through however much line is in the way.

cards.name: Quillguard
cards.where: Win Quill Path in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Rolls into a ball of very bad ideas for anyone who tries to grab it.

cards.name: Komodo Warlord
cards.where: Win Komodo Wallow in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Patient, armored, and in absolutely no hurry to lose. The bite is the least of the problem.

cards.name: Raccoon Bandit
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Washes its loot in the moat before deciding whether to keep it.

cards.name: Raccoon Warlord
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every raid it survives gets buried a little deeper. Cutting it down just means someone else digs up the hoard.

cards.name: Badger Berserker
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Digs in, then digs in further. Nobody has successfully asked it to leave.

cards.name: Beetle Battering-Ram
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A shell like a shield wall, lowered and driven straight through the middle of one.

cards.name: Crocodile Ambusher
cards.where: Win Old Snapjaw in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Floats like driftwood right up until it very much doesn’t.

cards.name: Raven Scout
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Circles once, marks a target, and dives before anyone finishes reading the omen.

cards.name: Wolf Pack Runner
cards.where: Win The Running Pack in The Pinewood Taiga (Conquest)
cards.fl: Never fights alone if it can help it. Fights anyway if it can’t.

cards.name: Boar Rampager
cards.where: Win Boar Wallow in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Does not so much choose a target as choose a direction.

cards.name: Turtle Bastion
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Brings its own fortifications. Nothing about it is in a hurry.

cards.name: Chipmunk Skirmisher
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Cheeks stuffed with acorns, morale, and absolutely nothing resembling caution.

cards.name: Eagle Diver
cards.where: Win The Gannet Queen in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: Announces itself with a strike, and only then with a screech.

cards.name: Octopus Tactician
cards.where: Win The Grotto Keeper in Smugglers' Grotto (Conquest)
cards.fl: Eight arms, eight opinions on how this fight should go. Usually gets its way.

cards.name: Nautilus Drifter
cards.where: Win Drifting Shell in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: A living fossil that has been quietly hoarding pearls since long before this castle was built.

cards.name: Alpha Howler
cards.where: Win The Howling Alpha in The Pinewood Taiga (Conquest)
cards.fl: One howl and the whole tree line answers. It rarely fights alone, and it rarely needs to.

cards.name: Tusked Vanguard
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Small, angry, and completely uninterested in which direction anyone else is running.

cards.name: Snapper Hatchling
cards.where: Win Snapping Reeds in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Barely bigger than a coin, already wearing full plate. Give it a few decades.

cards.name: Snapstick Turtle
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It found the perfect stick in the shallows. It will not be sharing it.

cards.name: Chipmunk Stockpiler
cards.where: Win Hedge Mice in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Cheeks packed with acorns it insists are for winter. The war chest disagrees.

cards.name: Eyrie Warden
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Watches from a height nothing else can reach, then arrives before the watching is noticed.

cards.name: Badger Sapper
cards.where: Win Badger Setts in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Tunnels under the wall instead of over it. The wall rarely notices until it's too late to matter.

cards.name: Raven Harbinger
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Its call is an old, bad omen. Whatever it lands on tends to prove the omen right.

cards.name: Bear Cub
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: All paws and no plan. The plan arrives in a year or two.

cards.name: Woodland Brawler
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Settles every argument the same way: badly, loudly, and in its own favor.

cards.name: Grizzly Vanguard
cards.where: Win Grizzly Ridge in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: One swipe was always going to hit more than one target. Nobody told the line to stand so close together.

cards.name: Cave Warlord
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Wakes up exactly once a fight, and the ground remembers it for longer than that.

cards.name: Fawn Scout
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Freezes first, bolts second, and somehow still ends up exactly where the fighting is.

cards.name: Antler Skirmisher
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Rack of antlers sharpened on every gatepost between here and the tree line.

cards.name: Stag Knight
cards.where: Win Antler Grove in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Winters on the high ridge alone. Nothing about a battlefield chill bothers it much.

cards.name: Elderhorn Monarch
cards.where: Win The Stag-Lord in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: The oldest set of antlers in the Bramblewood. Even the raccoons pay it tribute.

cards.name: Fox Kit
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Quick teeth, quicker exit. Rarely still there by the time you've noticed the bite.

cards.name: Firetail Trickster
cards.where: Win Fox Run in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Nine tales, one of them true, and a tail that's genuinely on fire. Ask it which is which.

cards.name: Fox Warchief
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Never fights the fight in front of it — always the two or three fights just past that one.

cards.name: Beaver Builder
cards.where: Win Beaver Dam in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: Shows up already carrying a stick it clearly means to sell you back later.

cards.name: Dam Wall
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Built in an afternoon out of whatever was lying around. Somehow still standing next spring.

cards.name: Lodge Engineer
cards.where: Win The Lodge in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: Never stops building, never stops taxing everyone downstream for the privilege.

cards.name: Riverworks Bastion
cards.where: Win The Lodge Matriarch in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: A fortress of logs and mud that has outlasted three winters and at least one siege.

cards.name: Grass Viper
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: You won't see it in the grass. You'll just start feeling it a moment later.

cards.name: Adder Ambusher
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Coiled and patient right up until it very much isn't.

cards.name: Constrictor Coil
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Doesn't so much attack a line as wrap around the whole thing at once.

cards.name: Venomlord Serpent
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Immune to its own venom, which is the only mercy anyone's ever found in it.

cards.name: Cave Flitter
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Impossible to hit in a straight line, mostly because it refuses to fly in one.

cards.name: Echo Screecher
cards.where: Win Glowworm Deep in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Finds you by sound alone, which is somehow worse than finding you by sight.

cards.name: Bat Swarmling
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Not drafted, not bought — just one more shape that peels off the roost when it's disturbed.

cards.name: Vampire Roost
cards.where: Win The Roost Above in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Knock it down and the whole colony scatters at once, still very much looking for dinner.

cards.name: Field Mouse
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Slips through the pantry, the granary, and eventually the war budget.

cards.name: Mouse Sapper
cards.where: Win Rodent Court in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Too small to stop, too determined to bother trying to stop.

cards.name: Rodent King
cards.where: Win The Briar Queen in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Crowned by acclamation of every mouse in the granary. The granary has a lot of mice.

cards.name: Stable Colt
cards.where: Win Colt Meadow in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Not trained for war yet. Kicks like it already is.

cards.name: Squire's Mount
cards.where: Win Squire Road in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Carried a squire into three skirmishes before the squire caught up to it in nerve.

cards.name: Warhorse Charger
cards.where: Win Charge of the Warhorses in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Barding, blinders, and absolutely no intention of slowing down for the enemy line.

cards.name: Cataphract Destrier
cards.where: Win The Horse-Lord in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Gilded from crest to hoof, it keeps the old road out of the wood. Most who meet it there turn back. The wise ones come back later.

cards.name: Puddle Hopper
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Croaks once before every fight. Nobody's figured out if it's a warning or a taunt.

cards.name: Poison Dart Croaker
cards.where: Win Croaker Chorus in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: Small, brilliantly colored, and a genuinely terrible idea to touch.

cards.name: Bog Behemoth
cards.where: Win Behemoth Bog in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Older than the castle, wider than the moat, and in absolutely no hurry to leave the mud.

cards.name: Warren Scout
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Out of the burrow and back in it before anyone's sure it was ever there.

cards.name: Lucky Hopper
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Carries a foot that isn't its own for luck. Doesn't ask where the previous owner went.

cards.name: Buck Brawler
cards.where: Win Warren Run in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Kicks first, apologizes never. Mostly because there's rarely anyone left to apologize to.

cards.name: Hanging Loafer
cards.where: Win Sloth Boughs in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Took four rounds just to open its eyes. Worth the wait, mostly.

cards.name: Ancient Sloth Titan
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Has been hanging from that same branch since before the castle had a name. In no rush to change that.

cards.name: Pond Paddler
cards.where: Win Duck Row in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: Looks entirely unbothered above the waterline. Paddling furiously the whole time underneath.

cards.name: Mallard Marauder
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Comes in low over the water and hits harder than something this size has any right to.

cards.name: Glacial Ape-King
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The Yeti's elder. Rarely leaves the high passes, and the passes are grateful for that.

cards.name: Sand Widow
cards.where: Win Widow's Web in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Weaves its web between two dunes and waits exactly as long as the desert does.

cards.name: Orca Vanguard
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Hunts in a pack that never needs to be told the plan twice.

cards.name: Quill Volley
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Doesn't wait to be grabbed. Fires first and rolls into a ball to think it over later.

cards.name: Stone Turtle Warden
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Nothing wrong with a slow answer, so long as it's the same answer every time: no.

cards.name: Quill-Thorn Boar
cards.where: Win Thornvine Arch in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: It never learned to dodge. It never had to.

cards.name: Berserker Boar
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Wounded, it stops defending entirely. That is not recklessness. That is the plan.

cards.name: Pack Wolf Reaver
cards.where: Win Reaver's Hollow in The Pinewood Taiga (Conquest)
cards.fl: One howl, three targets down. The pack was never really three wolves — just one idea, worn three ways.

cards.name: Raven Hexcaller
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It doesn't fight the blade. It just quietly convinces the arm holding it that swinging sounds exhausting.

cards.name: Eagle Sharpshooter
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every round, one arrow, one target. The arrow is not the point — the eye is.

cards.name: Hawk Arrowkeeper
cards.where: Win Hawk Watch in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: Two arrows, always. One for the target, one for anyone thinking of helping.

cards.name: Shrine Acolyte
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every dawn, the same quiet request. Most gods ignore it. This one apparently doesn't.

cards.name: Shrine High Priest
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Arrives already mid-sermon. Somehow, the shrine's coffers are heavier for it.

cards.name: Blessed Avatar
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Gold can't buy this one a place on the field. Devotion, apparently, can.

cards.name: Hollow Oath-Keeper
cards.where: Win The Oath Ring in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: It asks for a name, not gold. Whichever card you hand over doesn't come back.

cards.name: Bone Diviner
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It reads the fallen for omens, then quietly removes them from the story. Every kill it makes afterward pays for the reading.

cards.name: Insect Swarmling
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: One bite. Barely worth noticing. There will be more.

cards.name: Colony
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Strike it once, and a thousand more answer.

cards.name: Nest
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The first one out of the nest always flies a little faster.

cards.name: Howler Monkey
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Announces every ambush loudly, in advance, on principle.

cards.name: Jaguar Stalker
cards.where: Win The Jaguar's Path in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: The canopy does not rustle. Then it is already too late.

cards.name: Toucan Courier
cards.where: Win Dart Frogs in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Trades gossip and acorns at a very favorable exchange rate.

cards.name: Poison Dart Frog
cards.where: Win Dart Frogs in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Small, bright, and a genuinely terrible idea to lick.

cards.name: Strangler Vine
cards.where: Win Strangler Arch in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Started as a houseguest. Now it is load-bearing.

cards.name: Acacia Giraffe
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Sees the whole fight coming from a very comfortable distance.

cards.name: Savanna Cheetah
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Already at the bramble by the time the wait timer means anything.

cards.name: Dust Hyena
cards.where: Win The Dry Well in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: Laughs last, laughs loudest, keeps the change.

cards.name: Termite Mound
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Looks like scenery. Fights like a fortress.

cards.name: Plains Zebra
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: The stripes are not camouflage. They are a dare.

cards.name: Snow Owl Sentinel
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Silent wings, a very good memory for who owes it a hit.

cards.name: Tundra Musk Ox
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The herd forms a wall. This one IS the wall.

cards.name: Arctic Fox Raider
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: White on white on white, gone before you register the crunch of snow.

cards.name: Permafrost Mammoth
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Thawed out ill-tempered and has not warmed up since.

cards.name: Ice-Crevasse Wolf
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Every bite leaves something that keeps bleeding long after the fight moves on.

cards.name: Clownfish Scout
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Small, orange, and somehow always exactly where the hit was headed.

cards.name: Coral Reef Shark
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Circles once out of professional courtesy. Then does not.

cards.name: Moray Ambusher
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Lives in a hole in the reef and in your nightmares, respectively.

cards.name: Sea Turtle Elder
cards.where: Win The Old Shell in Pebble Beach (Conquest)
cards.fl: Has outlived several reefs. Intends to outlive this fight too.

cards.name: Coral Polyp Colony
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Builds itself one grain at a time, and never once stops billing for it.

cards.name: Mountain Goat Climber
cards.where: Win Goat Ledge in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: Footing that should not exist, used with total confidence.

cards.name: Golden Eagle Diver
cards.where: Win Eagle Stoop in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: Stoops from a height that makes the math feel unfair.

cards.name: Alpine Avalanche
cards.where: Win Avalanche Pass in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: Started as a pebble. Nobody agrees on whose fault that was.

cards.name: Rockslide Ram
cards.where: Win Rockfall in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: Charges downhill. Somehow charges harder every time.

cards.name: Peak Condor
cards.where: Win Condor Thermals in Gannet Cliffs (Conquest)
cards.fl: One devastating pass, then a long climb back to altitude.

cards.name: Bog Leech
cards.where: Win Leech Pools in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Attaches, drains, and is philosophically opposed to letting go.

cards.name: Swamp Alligator
cards.where: Win Gator Slide in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Ninety percent patience, ten percent an extremely bad day for someone.

cards.name: Mire Witch-Heron
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: One long stare and the fight already looks worse for you.

cards.name: Marsh Gas Toad
cards.where: Win Toad Hollow in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Swells, glows faintly, and gives everyone a two-round warning it counts on you ignoring.

cards.name: Cypress Root Lurker
cards.where: Win Cypress Roots in Gatorback Swamp (Conquest)
cards.fl: Rooted so deep the ground itself seems to be taking the hit.

cards.name: Cave Bat Swarm
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: One bat is a nuisance. This is never just one bat.

cards.name: Blind Cave Fish
cards.where: Win Glowworm Grotto in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Cannot see the attack coming. Dodges it anyway, out of habit.

cards.name: Stalactite Golem
cards.where: Win The Stalactite Warden in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Falls. Lands. Reconsiders its posture for a round. Falls again.

cards.name: Glowworm Cluster
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Lights the tunnel and, somehow, the collection plate.

cards.name: Cave Bear
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Calm all winter. Do not be there when it wakes.

cards.name: Magma Salamander
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Cooled just enough to hold a shape. Not enough to be safe to touch.

cards.name: Ash Cloud Condor
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A wingbeat of ash and grit — the first thing anyone opposite it does is cough and freeze.

cards.name: Obsidian Scorpion

cards.fl: Carries only On Death: Spawn -- On Death: spawns a Training Dummy onto this row -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

cards.fl: A plain Custom Trigger, nothing else: On Spawn, deals 5 damage to the opposite creature. For testing the trigger system itself in isolation from any named skill.

cards.fl: A plain Custom Trigger, nothing else: Per Turn, heals itself for 3. For testing the trigger system itself in isolation from any named skill.
