cards.fl: Carries only Stagger -- has a chance per landed attack to Stagger the target (-50% damage dealt) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

cards.name: Bonebreaker
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every blow lands like a falling tree. The ones who get back up wish they hadn't.

cards.name: Big Bee
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: When the hive runs dry, this is what crawls out instead.

cards.name: Wandering Traveller
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: No banner, no faction — just a walking stick, a full pack, and a knack for showing up exactly when a new adventure needs a guide.

cards.name: Frog
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Out of cards, out of ideas — but never out of frogs.

cards.name: Fly
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: There is always one more fly.

cards.name: Harvest Mouse
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Lives in the wheat. Knows every stalk by name.

cards.name: Garden Snail
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Slow to arrive. Slower to leave.

cards.name: Hedgehog Scout
cards.where: Win Cricket Chorus in Thistlewood (Conquest)
cards.fl: Curls up first, asks questions later.

cards.name: Meadow Frog
cards.where: Win Hedgerow Scouts in Thistlewood (Conquest)
cards.fl: Jumps into every puddle and every fight.

cards.name: Pill Bug
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Rolls into a ball. Rolls back out. Repeat.

cards.name: Sparrow Chick
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Hungry, loud, and surprisingly brave.

cards.name: Rabbit Kit
cards.where: Reward for winning the tutorial
cards.fl: First to the clover. First to the fight.

cards.name: Beetle Grunt
cards.where: Win Sapper Hedge in Thistlewood (Conquest)
cards.fl: Polished shell, simple orders, no complaints.

cards.name: Earthworm
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Cut it in half and it just keeps working.

cards.name: Dormouse
cards.where: Win Burrow Line in Thistlewood (Conquest)
cards.fl: Asleep for most of the war. Awake for the important part.

cards.name: Guppy
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Bright, tiny, and absolutely sure it is a shark.

cards.name: Tiny Cave Dweller
cards.where: A secret somewhere on the road
cards.fl: Clutches a chipped little shell of gold. Will not explain where it got it.

cards.name: Blizzard
cards.where: Win Ice Fang Patrol in Wolfsbane Tundra (Conquest)
cards.fl: The whole valley goes white, and everything on it slows to a crawl.

cards.name: Heatwave
cards.where: Win Zebra Stampede in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: Even the stones sweat. The weak wilt first.

cards.name: Spring Rain
cards.where: Win Harvest Mice in Clovermead (Conquest)
cards.fl: Soft rain on tired fur. Everyone feels it, friend and foe.

cards.name: Thick Fog
cards.where: Win Hermit Row in Pebble Beach (Conquest)
cards.fl: You can hear them out there. You just cannot see them.

cards.name: Full Moon
cards.where: Win Smugglers' Stash in Smugglers' Grotto (Conquest)
cards.fl: Night creatures do not wait for the sun to set.

cards.name: Beaver Lumberjack
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Two logs before breakfast, every single day.

cards.name: Courier Pigeon
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Brings a letter. Sometimes it even brings the right one.

cards.name: Echo Keeper
cards.where: Win Mire Ambush in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: It lights a candle for each name it lets go. The names don't stay gone.

cards.name: Marsh Wisp
cards.where: Win Leech Bog in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: Put it out and it drifts off. Light two candles and it drifts back.

cards.name: Bog Revenant
cards.where: Win Crocodile Run in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: The mire keeps what it drowns. Sometimes it gives one back.

cards.name: The Unremembered
cards.where: Win The Alligator King in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: Nobody can say what it was called. Every time it comes back, it is a little more certain of itself.

cards.name: Cinder Imp
cards.where: Win Quill Line in Ashen Spurn (Conquest)
cards.fl: It turns up whenever someone mutters a wish near a fire. It is not the help they wanted.

cards.name: Ash Imp
cards.where: Win Cinder Swarm in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Made of what's left after a fire, and very proud of it.

cards.name: Pit Glutton
cards.where: Win Salamander Vents in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Feed it once and it learns to spit what it ate.

cards.name: Brimstone Hound
cards.where: Win Vent Skitter in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: It bites whatever is nearest, then whatever is next to that.

cards.name: Blackmass Acolyte
cards.where: Win Ashfall Line in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every step it takes leaves the ground a little less holy.

cards.name: Dread Bell
cards.where: Win Ashfall Line in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: When it rings, nobody on the other side remembers what they were about to do.

cards.name: Tithe Collector
cards.where: Win Basalt Vanguard in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: It takes one card from your hand. You never find out which one until it's gone.

cards.name: Lurking Dread
cards.where: Win Titan's Shadow in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Put it down and it waits in the dark until there's enough dark to climb back out.

cards.name: Puppeteer Imp
cards.where: Win The Pyroclast Wyrm in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: It never fights. It just finds someone on the other side who will.

cards.name: The Sixfold
cards.where: Win The Phoenix Ember King in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Six must fall, six must be drawn, six must bleed the walls. Then it opens its eyes.

cards.name: Fleetfoot'd
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Already halfway down the riverbank before anyone said go.

cards.name: Crossed-Eyes
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Looks at two things at once and pecks a third.

cards.name: Chapel Sparrow
cards.where: Win Bee Lines in Clovermead (Conquest)
cards.fl: Sings the same three notes every morning. The bells learned them from it.

cards.name: Candle Moth
cards.where: Win Goat Trail Runners in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Keeps vigil by the candle. Too close, sometimes.

cards.name: Hymn Wren
cards.where: Win Avalanche Ridge in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Louder with every voice that joins in.

cards.name: Abbey Goose
cards.where: Win Cliffside Herd in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Tends the infirmary. Hisses at the patients anyway.

cards.name: Golden Magpie
cards.where: Win Ridge Fork in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Everything it touches turns to gold, mostly by stealing it.

cards.name: Friar Badger
cards.where: Win West Ledge in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Never misses a meal, and never once missed a prayer.

cards.name: Storm Heron
cards.where: Win East Ledge in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Stands in the rain on purpose. The rain listens.

cards.name: Vigil Owl
cards.where: Win Eyrie Wardens in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Watches over the fallen, and remembers who felled them.

cards.name: Cathedral Eagle
cards.where: Win The Cathedral Eagle in The Quiet Summit (Conquest)
cards.fl: When it lands on the spire, the whole valley goes quiet.

cards.name: Ironmaw Warwolf
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Twice the height of a cart, with blades bolted to its flanks and brow and steel on every claw and tooth. The monkey on its back, Kip, does the steering. This is not a pet. This is the war, walking.

cards.name: Weredog
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: A good boy at noon. At midnight, a very large and not-so-good boy.

cards.name: Parish Sergeant
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Keeps the village roll, the lantern oil and the peace, in that order.

cards.name: Land Tiller
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Turns the soil at dawn, the bread at noon and in early at dusk.

cards.name: Village Miller
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Flour on the whiskers, a sack on the back, and a price for everyone.

cards.name: Night Watchman
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Calls the hours. Nobody asked it to, but nobody sleeps through a fire either.

cards.name: Otter Ferryman
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: One copper across, two back, and a song for free whether you want it or not.

cards.name: Otter Netmender
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Mends the nets, then the fences, then whoever got tangled in either.

cards.name: Nectar Vintner
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Ferments the morning's blossoms into something the whole roost regrets by evening.

cards.name: Dawn Bellringer
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: A hummingbird with a bell three times its size and no sense of the hour.

cards.name: Guardian Shield
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Planted in the mud by a dog who decided you were worth protecting.

cards.name: Shieldbearer Hound
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Carries a round shield on its back and drops it in front of whoever it decides is in trouble.

cards.name: Stoat Cutthroat
cards.where: Win Stoat Ambush in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Never where you're looking. Always where you aren't.

cards.name: Two-Headed Calf
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Both heads want to go in different directions. Both heads win.

cards.name: Upside-Down Bat
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Sleeps all night, hangs the wrong way up, and is very pleased with itself.

cards.name: Teatime Toad
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Never in a hurry. There is always time for one more cup.

cards.name: Mirror Moth
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: You swing at it, and somehow you're the one who gets hit.

cards.name: Snail Mail
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Your letters arrive. Eventually. All at once.

cards.name: Glass Golem
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Hits like a landslide. Please don't touch it.

cards.name: Wrong-Way Salmon
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Swims downstream on purpose. Nobody ever sees it coming.

cards.name: Inside-Out Hedgehog
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Soft on the outside, prickly on the inside, which is somehow worse.

cards.name: Talon Archer
cards.where: Win Archer Hill in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: Holds the bow in one foot, draws with the other, and has never once explained how.

cards.name: Sergeant Bramblefox
cards.where: Win Frost Vanguard in Bramblewood Outskirts (Conquest)
cards.fl: Barks the orders, then runs in first anyway.

cards.name: The Thistle Baron
cards.where: Win The Thistle Baron in Thistlewood (Conquest)
cards.fl: He owns every stalk from here to the dunes, and he counts them.

cards.name: The Old Shell
cards.where: Win The Old Shell in Pebble Beach (Conquest)
cards.fl: It came up the beach before the castle was built.

cards.name: The Drowned Matriarch
cards.where: Win The Drowned Colossus in Sunken Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every spawnling in the Hollow answers to her.

cards.name: Yeti Chieftain
cards.where: Win The Frost Yeti King in Ashen Spurn (Conquest)
cards.fl: The summit belongs to whatever survives the cold longest.

cards.name: Echo Matriarch
cards.where: Win The Stalactite Warden in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Her shriek finds you in the dark before her teeth do.

cards.name: Pride Queen
cards.where: Win The Savanna Warlord in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: The grass goes quiet a full second before she arrives.

cards.name: Wolfsbane Alpha
cards.where: Win The Glacial Ape-King in Wolfsbane Tundra (Conquest)
cards.fl: The pack howls. He does not need to.

cards.name: Reef Admiral
cards.where: Win The Orca Vanguard King in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: Commands the whole reef with a flick of one fin.

cards.name: The Heron Hag
cards.where: Win The Alligator King in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: She stands on one leg in the mist and waits for the swamp to bring her something.

cards.name: Shell-Cracker
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Floats on its back, cracks a mussel on its belly, and asks if you want the rest.

cards.name: Rivergate Recruit
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Issued one shield, one spear and one very long list of rules.

cards.name: Riverstone Slinger
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Skips stones for fun. Skips them off hummingbirds for work.

cards.name: Net Thrower
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: A weighted net, a good arm, and a sky full of targets.

cards.name: Optio of the Ford
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Second in command, first in the water.

cards.name: Marshal of Rivergate
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Twenty winters on the river wall. The wall is newer than she is.

cards.name: Daily Post
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Rain, wind or war: the mail gets through by noon.

cards.name: Petal Fletcher
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Fletches every arrow with a single dyed petal. It matters to her.

cards.name: Nectar Sipper
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Never more than a wingbeat from the next flower.

cards.name: Sunfeather Scout
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Maps the meadows from above and sells the maps below.

cards.name: Lantern Bearer
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Where the lantern goes, the morning follows.

cards.name: Hush-Wing Spy
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: The only hummingbird that has learned to hum quietly.

cards.name: Ruby-Throat Duelist
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Strikes first, bows second, never apologises.

cards.name: Sunspire Choirmother
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Every bird that joins the flock joins the song.

cards.name: Ferry Toll-Frog
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: One acorn to cross. Two if you look at it funny.

cards.name: Riverside Peddler
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Sells to otters and birds alike. Mostly the same buttons.

cards.name: Ford Kingfisher
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Belongs to neither side, and dives on both.

cards.name: Truce Heron
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Neither side dares to strike the heron. It is counting on that.

cards.name: Old Willow of the Ford
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: The truce was signed in its shade. It remembers every word.

cards.name: Iron Shard
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A sliver of old castle iron. The Blacksmith wants all of them.

cards.name: River Pearl
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Grown slowly in a river mussel. Otters swear they are lucky.

cards.name: Ember Core
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Still warm, years after it left the fire.

cards.name: Dragon Scale
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Nobody has seen a dragon in Bramblewood for a hundred years. Nobody can explain this scale either.

cards.name: Bark Buckler
cards.where: The Blacksmith: craft it at the Forge
cards.fl: Three layers of oak bark and a lot of optimism.

cards.name: Netmender's Harpoon
cards.where: The Blacksmith: craft it at the Forge
cards.fl: Mends nets by day. Brings down hummingbirds by night.

cards.name: Quill Spear
cards.where: The Blacksmith: craft it at the Forge
cards.fl: A porcupine quill as long as an otter, bound to an ash shaft.

cards.name: Sunfeather Plume
cards.where: The Blacksmith: craft it at the Forge
cards.fl: Worn in the hair, it lifts more than your spirits.

cards.name: Siege Hammer
cards.where: The Blacksmith: craft it at the Forge
cards.fl: Built for walls. Works on everything else too.

cards.name: Dragonscale Mail
cards.where: The Blacksmith: craft it at the Forge
cards.fl: Every scale turns a blade. Every one of them came from somewhere.

cards.name: Puddle Changeling
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: It looked like a frog yesterday. Today it looks like whatever you were hoping for.

cards.name: Hedge Changeling
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Every army has one more soldier than it counted. Nobody minds; it brings snacks.

cards.name: Glass Changeling
cards.where: The Mystery Booster (from the wandering trader)
cards.fl: Its wings show you your own face. It is usually smiling.

cards.name: Tempering Stone
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A whetstone quenched in river water and ember ash. The last few levels of a great card need one.

cards.name: Willow-o'-Wisp
cards.where: Win Toad Chorus in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: A beetle made of shadow, with one cold light in its tail. Where it hovers over the willows, the fallen don't stay in the ground.

cards.name: Cinder Stoker
cards.where: Win Slag Runners in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Keeps the forge-pits fed by crawling into them. Charges by the shovel.

cards.name: Pack Mule
cards.where: Win Panther Ledge in The Sundered Peak (Conquest)
cards.fl: Carries the cavalry’s firewood up the mountain, and its opinions down again.

cards.name: Tailwind
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Somewhere upriver a heron sneezed, and the whole line got there early.

cards.name: Bramble Gauntlet
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Woven thorn-side out. Shake hands at your own risk.

cards.name: Thornwood Palisade
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Sharpened stakes, lashed tight. It never charges, but it never forgets who swung first.

cards.name: Conch Crawler
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Most of it is shell. The rest of it is opinions about the shell.

cards.name: Conch Herald
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: One long note on a borrowed conch, and the whole tide line stands a little taller.

cards.name: Shoal Shark
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It comes in with the tide, and it comes in fast.

cards.name: Malachite Golem
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Green stone, banded like old water. It curls up the moment anything touches it, and it does not uncurl quickly.

cards.name: Irradiated Axolotl
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It glows in the dark. It glows in the light, too.

cards.name: Irradiated Glow Wyrm
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The tunnel it leaves behind is lit for a week.

cards.name: Irradiated Couatl
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The feathered serpent of the old songs, if the old songs had been sung inside a reactor.

cards.name: Heartwood Treant
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every log in your pile is a cousin. It takes that personally.

cards.name: Quarry Troll
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It is built from what you dug up, and it remembers every pick.

cards.name: Iron Warden
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Feed it metal and it stands up straighter.

cards.name: Badger Lumberjack
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Whatever you chop, it chops one more.

cards.name: Ore-Smelter Mole
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Comes up with a nugget most days, and a bigger one on the good ones.

cards.name: Sworn Shieldbearer
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Stands taller when the banner is up.

cards.name: Crown Pretender
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every leader it sees is a seat it could be sitting in.

cards.name: Grindstone Boar
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Strong, and absolutely no fun to stand next to.

cards.name: Rainmaker Frog
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It croaks once, and the sky answers.

cards.name: Puddle Skimmer
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Dry ground slows it down. Wet ground does not slow anything down.

cards.name: Moonlit Hare
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It counts the nights by the shape of the moon.

cards.name: Lunar Howler
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: At the full moon the whole valley hears it. At the new moon, nobody does.

cards.name: Frostbitten Wolverine
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every cold night makes it meaner.

cards.name: Skull Vulture
cards.where: Win Root Snare in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: It circles whatever is about to lose. It is rarely wrong.

cards.name: The Caldera Wyrm
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It sleeps in the mountain's heart. When it wakes, so does the mountain.

cards.name: The Contradiction
cards.where: Win Heart of the Mountain in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: A snow bear that came down into the fire and did not melt. Its heart glows red, and so do its fangs.

cards.name: Ashbone Ghoul
cards.where: Win The Ash Ossuary in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: The ash remembers its shape. Give it two candles' worth of reason and it stands back up.

cards.name: Cinder Skeleton
cards.where: Win The Wraith Vents in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: Knock it down once and it rattles. Knock it down twice and it finally takes the hint.

cards.name: Magma Wraith
cards.where: Win The Lich's Kiln in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: A shimmer over the vents that throws embers at anything warm-blooded.

cards.name: Pall Wraith
cards.where: Win The Wraith Vents in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: It walks through the valley of the shadow, and brings the shadow with it.

cards.name: Obsidian Lich
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It cut its own heart out of black glass, so nothing could ever break it again.

cards.name: Ember Revenant
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Once the mountain's sworn guard. The oath outlived the guard.

cards.name: Meerkat Wayfarer
cards.where: Reward for winning the tutorial
cards.fl: Another traveller on the same road. It stands up tall, spots the birds before anyone, and tells everyone else when to swing.

cards.name: Abyssal Ink
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A drop of the Goliath's ink, cold as the deep. Everyone who joins a raid brings one home.

cards.name: Strange Materia
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It hums in a key no smith can name. Only a map's master carries one, and the Forge will not grow without it.

cards.name: Creeper
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: A green bee with no face to speak of, only a smile. It never stops smiling. Whatever it is looking at stops wanting to hit it.

cards.name: Pigeon Peon
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Carries the messages, the crumbs and the blame. Mostly the blame.

cards.name: Marching Elephant
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It doesn't charge. It simply keeps walking, and the line ahead of it stops being a line.

cards.name: Siege Rhino
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every wall it meets becomes a door.

cards.name: Stonedrop Vulture
cards.where: Win Vulture Road in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: Egyptian vultures crack eggs by dropping stones on them. This one has moved on to bigger eggs.

cards.name: Newt Doctor
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Grows back its own tail, so it has no patience for your complaints about a scratch.

cards.name: Gatling Hog
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Spins, rattles, and empties its quills at whatever twitched first.

cards.name: Dung Beetle
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Rolls a ball three times its size uphill. You do not want to be the hill.

cards.name: Ür-Elk
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: An elk from before the ice. Its antlers are wider than your fort and twice as old.

cards.name: Subterraneaner
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Nobody has seen its face. The tunnel always comes up right under the bramble.

cards.name: Farm Dog
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A good dog. It barks at the right things and most of the wrong ones.

cards.name: House Cat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It will help. It will not be seen helping.

cards.name: Shellwright Apprentice
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Polishes shells for the Rivergate armouries, and keeps the best one for itself.

cards.name: Royal Guard
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Sworn to the Rivergate throne. The throne is a log, but the oath is real.

cards.name: Otter Flag Bearer
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Holds the river banner high. The others swing harder when they can see it.

cards.name: Otter Lantern Bearer
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Walks the night patrol along the weirs with a firefly jar.

cards.name: Riverbed Diver
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Breathes once, vanishes, and turns up behind you with a stone in its paw.

cards.name: Hummingbird Needler
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Its beak is a needle and it sews nothing.

cards.name: Riverwing Envoy
cards.where: Reward for winning the tutorial
cards.fl: An otter with a hummingbird on its shoulder, sent by both courts to keep the peace. Every new friend makes it bolder.

cards.name: Trojan Raider
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Out of the horse and into the fight.

cards.name: Nest Hatchling
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Fresh out of the Hidden Nest and already furious about it.

cards.name: Triumphvirate
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Three crowns were offered to the pride. He wears all three.

cards.name: Inkcloud Squid
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: It leaves a cloud the size of a barn and is three fields away before it settles.

cards.name: Abyss Lantern Squid
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: Down where the sun gives up, it is the only light. Things swim toward it. Then they stop swimming.

cards.name: Glass Octopus
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: You can see its heart beating. You cannot see where it is about to be.

cards.name: Vampire Squid
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: It folds its cloak over its head and waits. The river mouth has learned to wait too.

cards.name: Goliath Tentacle
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: One arm of eight. The boat it came up under is still somewhere above it.

cards.name: Goliath Broodmother
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: Every spawnling in the river mouth hatched under her. Every one of them will come when she calls.

cards.name: Cave Centipede
cards.where: Win Roost Flurry in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: A hundred legs, and every one of them is already moving toward you.

cards.name: Millipede Hauler
cards.where: Win Sulfur Vent Path in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: The beetles and ants call it the cart. It never complains, and it never stops.

cards.name: Thorny Devil
cards.where: Win Dune Jackals in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every inch of it says no.

cards.name: Fennec Fox
cards.where: Win Obsidian Nest in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Hears your plan before you finish thinking it.

cards.name: Meerkat Sentry
cards.where: Win Sandstorm in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: One stands watch. Twelve more are right behind it.

cards.name: Lone Grey Wolf
cards.where: Win Frostbitten Pack in Wolfsbane Tundra (Conquest)
cards.fl: Left the pack. The pack has regretted it ever since.

cards.name: Buzzed Chipmunk
cards.where: A Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Third cup. Fourth? Who is counting. Not the chipmunk.

cards.name: Scree Goat
cards.where: Win Porcupine Bastion in Ashen Spurn (Conquest)
cards.fl: Sure-footed on the way up. Takes the mountain with it on the way down.

cards.name: Rivergate Tribune
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: The Legion follows the crest. The crest follows her.

cards.name: Sunspire Sky-Sovereign
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: Faster than the sun can follow, and the sun has tried.

cards.name: Bombardier Beetle
cards.where: Win Web Hollow in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Boiling spray, perfect aim, zero regrets.

cards.name: Cunning Vixen
cards.where: Win Quill Path in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: You never see the trick. You only count what is missing afterwards.

cards.name: Fox Sharpshot
cards.where: Win Warren Run in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Waits for the gap in the line, then puts a bolt through it.

cards.name: Balloon Archer
cards.where: Win Ridge Fork in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: The basket was a picnic hamper. The patchwork was the bedspread. The bow was always a bow.

cards.name: Frillneck Duelist
cards.where: Win Komodo Wallow in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Flares the frill, raises the spiked fists, and asks if you would like to reconsider.

cards.name: Monitor Rambler
cards.where: Win Jaguar Run in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: Low, slow and plated. Kicking it is a lesson.

cards.name: Dynamite Packrat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Hoards everything shiny. Lately that includes the fuse.

cards.name: Helmeted Otter
cards.where: Any basic pack (Factions pool): Hedgerow Pouch, Tidemire Chest or Highcrest Case
cards.fl: The helmet is a cooking pot. It has stopped more arrows than any shield on the river.

cards.name: Bramble Hoglet
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Curls up under the brambles, has a little nap, and gets up feeling much better.

cards.name: Clover Butterfly
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Only comes out when the sun does. So does everyone, really, but she makes a fuss of it.

cards.name: The Gannet Queen
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Every ledge on the cliffs is hers. She lets the gulls borrow a few.

cards.name: Old Snapjaw
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Older than the swamp has a name for. He has never once been in a hurry, and never once missed.

cards.name: Alpine Marmot
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: One whistle and the whole burrow is safe. It whistles a lot.

cards.name: Meerkat Burrower
cards.where: Win Meerkat Warrens in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: Digs the tunnel, then digs another tunnel in case the first one gets ideas.

cards.name: Moon Jelly
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Drifts where the current goes. The current is very sorry about this.

cards.name: Lion's Mane Jelly
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Its tail is longer than a ferry. Nobody has ever found the end of it on purpose.

cards.name: Caiman Hatchling
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Small, fast and absolutely certain it is the biggest thing in the swamp.

cards.name: Mudpuppy
cards.where: Win Moss Weir in The Sunken Grove (Conquest)
cards.fl: Feathery gills, a permanent smile, and mud everywhere.

cards.name: Harbor Seal
cards.where: Win Lynx Ambush in Wolfsbane Tundra (Conquest)
cards.fl: Slips off the ice the moment you aim at it, and slides back on looking very pleased.

cards.name: Snow Ermine
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: White as the snow, except for the tail, which it cannot do anything about.

cards.name: Ember Centipede
cards.where: Win Obsidian Run in Volcano Lair (Conquest)
cards.fl: Its legs glow orange from walking on warm stone. It has never once been cold.

cards.name: Cinder Gecko
cards.where: Win Cinder Slopes in Volcano Lair (Conquest)
cards.fl: Sticks to any wall, even the hot ones. Especially the hot ones.

cards.name: Ash Moth
cards.where: Win Shrine Steps in The Sundered Peak (Conquest)
cards.fl: Grey as ash and drawn to the glow. It thinks the volcano is the biggest lantern in the world.

cards.name: Cave Olm
cards.where: Win Crystal Stair in The Glimmer Depths (Conquest)
cards.fl: Has lived in the dark so long it forgot it had eyes. It does not miss them.

cards.name: Glimmer Spider
cards.where: Win Shard Gallery in The Glimmer Depths (Conquest)
cards.fl: Spins its web out of the shiny bits. Things that like shiny things come to look.

cards.name: Field Crow
cards.where: Win Clover Patch in Clovermead (Conquest)
cards.fl: Comes for the seeds, stays for the gossip.

cards.name: Rabid Jackal
cards.where: Win Mirage Jackals in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: Foam at the mouth, fear of the river. Keep it away from both.

cards.name: Mirrorhide Mutant
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Something in the high ground changed it. Now there are two of it, and neither one is sure which came first.

cards.name: Growth Sprout
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Green and stubborn. Every swarm on the field counts it as one of its own.

cards.name: Shallows Fry
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Born in the green shallows, it has never seen deep water and is not in a hurry to.

cards.name: Vampire Bat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It drinks what it bites, and it bites hard.

cards.name: Wandering Mage
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A cat in a starry hat, a staff with a sky-blue orb, and a little fire spirit reading over its shoulder. It turns up on the far roads, past Map 50, the way the Traveller once did.

cards.name: Woodland Egg
cards.where: The Nest: set a Woodland Egg in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: Warm, brown and plain. Whatever is in it was born in the woods, and that is all anyone can say.

cards.name: Speckled Egg
cards.where: The Nest: set a Speckled Egg in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: Blue with brown freckles. Something inside it is already peeping.

cards.name: River Bundle
cards.where: The Nest: set a River Bundle in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: A reed basket, tied with river weed. It squeaks when the water rises.

cards.name: Leathery Egg
cards.where: The Nest: set a Leathery Egg in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: Soft as a glove and warm from the sand. It takes its time.

cards.name: Cocoon
cards.where: The Nest: set a Cocoon in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: Silk on silk. It twitches when nobody is looking.

cards.name: Roe Pearl
cards.where: The Nest: set a Roe Pearl in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: A cluster of glassy pearls that never quite dries out.

cards.name: Den Bundle
cards.where: The Nest: set a Den Bundle in a nest to get this egg card
cards.fl: Something small and furry, curled in a nest of moss. It growls in its sleep.

cards.name: Rafflesia
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The biggest flower in the forest, and it smells like a week-old carcass. Whatever stands across from it slowly loses the will to fight.

cards.name: Puffball Bombardier
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Lobs spore puffs over the line every round. Whatever breathes them in starts to feel poorly.

cards.name: Otter Angler
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Sits on the weir with a willow rod and a lot of patience. Comes home with supper, and something to trade for it.

cards.name: Honeyjoe Brewer
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Brews honeyjoe with the bees every dawn: nectar, a splash of honey, far too much coffee. The whole hive buzzes for hours.

cards.name: Voltwing Bat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Its wings crackle in the dark. Every cave it leaves smells faintly of storms.

cards.name: Static Bat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Rubs itself on the cave wall until its fur stands on end, then comes looking for a handshake.

cards.name: Arc Bat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Hangs from the iron veins deep underground and drinks the lightning that runs through them.

cards.name: Hammerhead Shark
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Swings that wide flat head through the shoal like a mallet, and senses who is hiding in the sand.

cards.name: Ironback Gorilla
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: The forge's smith. Its great mallet was meant for horseshoes; it works just as well on shields.

cards.name: Smokescreen Raccoon
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: By the time the smoke clears, so have your pockets.

cards.name: Blister Beetle
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Eat it and regret it. The birds that try it once never try it twice.

cards.name: Colossal Squid
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Sailors measure it in ships. The ships are never all there afterwards.

cards.name: Lantern Spark Fly
cards.where: Win The Gem Hoarder in The Glimmer Depths (Conquest)
cards.fl: Carries its light the way other moths chase one.

cards.name: Baby Bat
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: All ears, and still not listening.

cards.name: Baby Horned Capybara
cards.where: Win Gator Hollow in The Sunken Grove (Conquest)
cards.fl: The horns are new. So is everything else.

cards.name: Red Dragon Egg
cards.where: A hidden trail: follow the Dragon Scales
cards.fl: Warm as a hearthstone and twice as heavy. The ground around it never cools.

cards.name: Sheep
cards.where: Available from the start
cards.fl: Fluffy, stubborn, and impossible to walk past.

cards.name: Jay Pilferer
cards.where: Win Reef Skirmishers in Sunken Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: It never steals much. It just never stops.

cards.name: Border Collie
cards.where: Win Squire Road in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: One whistle and the whole field closes ranks, whether it meant to or not.

cards.name: Mongoose Duelist
cards.where: Win Hyena Chorus in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every snake in the line makes it grin wider.

cards.name: Dhole Runner
cards.where: Win Snowshoe Tracks in The Pinewood Taiga (Conquest)
cards.fl: Alone it is a red dog. Three abreast, it is a red tide.

cards.name: Dhole Matriarch
cards.where: Win The Running Pack in The Pinewood Taiga (Conquest)
cards.fl: She whistles, and the pack spreads out like fingers of a hand.

cards.name: Nightjar Drifter
cards.where: Win Moonlit Gills in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: It wakes when the light turns amber and sings until it turns grey.

cards.name: Aye-aye Prowler
cards.where: Win Strangler Arch in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Daylight is a rumour it has chosen not to believe.

cards.name: Hoopoe Herald
cards.where: Win Toucan Watch in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: A crown of feathers, a voice like a bell, and no idea where the moon went.

cards.name: Sunbittern Strider
cards.where: Win Kingfisher Dive in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: In the sun its wings flash an eye on each side. Nobody aims well at an eye.

cards.name: Kinkajou Lurker
cards.where: Win Sloth Boughs in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Honey bear by name, shadow by habit.

cards.name: Mudflat Godwit
cards.where: Win Mudflat Skippers in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: It follows the waterline like a tailor follows a hem.

cards.name: Moon Jerboa
cards.where: Win Scorpion Flats in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: On the full moon it hops higher than the dunes, and lands a little bigger.

cards.name: Werebadger
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Most nights it is a badger. Some nights it is more badger.

cards.name: Carrion Beetle
cards.where: Win Venomlord's Coil in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: Where it walks, wounds forget how to close.

cards.name: Marula Elephant
cards.where: Win Howler Canopy in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: The fruit was off. The elephant was on.

cards.name: Star-nosed Mole
cards.where: Win Rotting Roots in The Sunken Grove (Conquest)
cards.fl: Twenty-two fingers on its face, and not one of them can see.

cards.name: Pika Hoarder
cards.where: Win Tarn Shore in The Quiet Summit (Conquest)
cards.fl: It forgot where it left the hay. And the plan. And you.

cards.name: Tarantula Hawk
cards.where: Win Widow's Web in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Always awake, always buzzing, always one sting from going off.

cards.name: Swordfish Spearman
cards.where: Win The Undertow in The Sunken Depths (Conquest)
cards.fl: Three points, three targets, one very fast fish.

cards.name: Blue-ringed Octopus
cards.where: Win The Ferry's Last Passenger in The Sunken Depths (Conquest)
cards.fl: It is the size of a teacup and the temper of a storm.

cards.name: Pronghorn Racer
cards.where: Win Colt Meadow in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: It outran a cheetah that went extinct. It still runs as if it might come back.

cards.name: Roadrunner Courier
cards.where: Win Dune Jackals in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Beep beep, and it is already gone.

cards.name: Box Turtle
cards.where: Win Tidal Ring in Sunken Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Knock all you like. Nobody is home.

cards.name: Glasswing Butterfly
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: You see straight through it, and so do most swords.

cards.name: Velvet Worm
cards.where: Win Dart Frogs in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: It sprays glue when it hunts, and something worse when it is hurt.

cards.name: Glowing Gecko
cards.where: Win The Salt Pan in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: It lives near the old mine and does not need a lantern.

cards.name: Gloom Gibbon
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: At dusk it is a voice in the canopy. At night it is barely a voice.

cards.name: Margay
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Two eyes in the dark, and then not even those.

cards.name: Seed-cache Squirrel
cards.where: Win Hedge Mice in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every acorn it forgets becomes somebody else's problem. Or ally.

cards.name: Leafcutter Gardener
cards.where: Win Grub Tunnels in The Morel Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: It carries a leaf ten times its size, and a garden in its head.

cards.name: Lotus Frog
cards.where: Win Lily Hop in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: When the water rises under the moon, it opens like the flower it sits on.

cards.name: Planarian Splitter
cards.where: Win Root Cellar in The Mycelium Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Cut it in half and you have done it a favour.

cards.name: Hagfish Silencer
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: What it bites stays bitten. Nothing else happens.

cards.name: Electric Ray
cards.where: Win Moray Ambush in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: It hums quietly on the seabed, counting.

cards.name: Vampire Bat Nurse
cards.where: Win Cinder Vents in Caves & Alcoves (Conquest)
cards.fl: Strange how gently it tends the ones that bleed.

cards.name: Lichen Tortoise
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Moss on its shell, stone in its bones, and the old wild in its slow heart.

cards.name: Swift Fox
cards.where: Win Fox Run in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: It was named before anyone saw the other foxes.

cards.name: Slow Loris
cards.where: Win The Jaguar's Path in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Its eyes are huge, its grip is soft, and its bite is something else.

cards.name: Hercules Beetle
cards.where: Win Drum Circle in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: It lifts a hundred times its weight and assumes you are lighter.

cards.name: Mayfly Dancer
cards.where: Win Pike Shallows in Lilypad Reach (Conquest)
cards.fl: A single day, and it means to make it count.

cards.name: Pangolin Roller
cards.where: Win Zebra Stampede in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: Scales like a pinecone, and as hard to argue with.

cards.name: Sawfish
cards.where: Win Riptide Channel in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: A saw for a nose, and armour is just more wood.

cards.name: Tasmanian Devil
cards.where: Win Boar Wallow in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Lose a friend near it and watch it lose its mind.

cards.name: Mantis Shrimp
cards.where: Win Eel Nest in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: It punches so hard the water boils. Sometimes so does its own shell.

cards.name: Fruit-bat Familiar
cards.where: Win Furnace Mouth in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Wherever it hangs, the room gets a little darker.

cards.name: Hellbender
cards.where: Win Salamander Vents in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Its name does most of the work. The rest is teeth.

cards.name: Woodpecker Sapper
cards.where: Win Cub Clearing in The Redwood Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Bark, armour, shield: it is all just wood to a woodpecker.

cards.name: Snow Bunting Archer
cards.where: Win Snowshoe Line in Wolfsbane Tundra (Conquest)
cards.fl: Each feather a frost, each arrow a winter.

cards.name: Spitting Cobra
cards.where: Win The Cheetah Matriarch in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: Two jets, two eyes, two problems.

cards.name: Echidna Quillshot
cards.where: Win Badger Warband in Ashen Spurn (Conquest)
cards.fl: One shake and the whole line is pinned.

cards.name: Firefly Swarm
cards.where: Win Silverback Watch in The Sundered Peak (Conquest)
cards.fl: Pretty lights, hot lights, hotter lights.

cards.name: Archerfish
cards.where: Win Drifting Shell in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: It spits from under the water and never misses a fly. Or a face.

cards.name: Spitting Spider
cards.where: Win The Rime Hall in The Ice Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: It does not weave a web. It throws one, wet.

cards.name: Ice Petrel
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It spits a sleet that freezes as it flies.

cards.name: Electric Catfish
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: A spark, a crack, and the water remembers.

cards.name: Dust-devil Kestrel
cards.where: Win Dust Devils in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: It hovers, and the dust starts to spin with it.

cards.name: Ibex Rockcaller
cards.where: Win The Avalanche Colossus in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: One bleat from the high ledge and the whole slope listens.

cards.name: Sperm Whale Elder
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: When it dives, the sea leans in after it.

cards.name: Thunder Lizard
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Not a dragon. Do not tell it that.

cards.name: Corpse-flower Beetle
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Everything it touches remembers it is going to die.

cards.name: Salamander Pyromancer
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It breathes once on its hands, and the world goes orange.

cards.name: Starfall Owl
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It looks up. So does everything else, too late.

cards.name: Armadillo Guard
cards.where: Win Sandstorm in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: A coat of plates, a little spare, just in case.

cards.name: Elephant-nose Fish
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It reads the water with electricity, and you with something worse.

cards.name: Piranha Shoal
cards.where: Win Monitor Roots in The Kelp Mangroves (Conquest)
cards.fl: One drop and the whole shoal remembers it is hungry.

cards.name: Chilli Parrot
cards.where: Win Drum Circle in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: Birds do not feel the heat of a pepper. Everything near it does.

cards.name: Platypus Spur
cards.where: Win Cetacean Pod in Sunken Hollow (Conquest)
cards.fl: Duck bill, otter fur, and a spur nobody warned you about.

cards.name: Cone Snail
cards.where: Win Tide Pool Line in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: A pretty shell, a slow crawl, and a harpoon full of something that never wears off.

cards.name: Lamprey
cards.where: Win Leech Bog in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: It does not take much. It just does not give it back.

cards.name: Paper Wasp
cards.where: Win Bee Lines in Clovermead (Conquest)
cards.fl: Fierce at first. Then softer with every swat.

cards.name: Bison Bulldozer
cards.where: Win Archer Hill in The Long Grass (Conquest)
cards.fl: It lowers its head, and the line moves back a step.

cards.name: Weaver Bird
cards.where: Win Giraffe Vanguard in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: It ties knots for a living, and ankles for fun.

cards.name: Anaconda Coil
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It does not bite. It just holds on, and on, and on.

cards.name: Tardigrade
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Boil it, freeze it, crush it: it will simply wait.

cards.name: Leaf Chameleon
cards.where: Win Dart Frogs in The Canopy (Conquest)
cards.fl: You walked past it twice. It counted.

cards.name: Oilbird
cards.where: Win The Echo Pool in The Glimmer Depths (Conquest)
cards.fl: It clicks through the dark and finds you anyway.

cards.name: Skunk Gasser
cards.where: Win Quill Path in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: It lifts its tail, and the whole enemy line reconsiders.

cards.name: Ice Fish
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Its blood never freezes. Everything else does.

cards.name: Fire Salamander
cards.where: Win Slag Runners in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Old tales say it was born in a fire. It agrees.

cards.name: Fire Hawk
cards.where: Win Grizzly Frontier in The Sundered Peak (Conquest)
cards.fl: It drops a burning twig, and waits for whatever runs out.

cards.name: Flagellant Vulture
cards.where: Win Ashfall Line in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: It pays for every meal in its own feathers.

cards.name: Vampire Finch
cards.where: Win Basalt Vanguard in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: A small bird with a small beak and a large appetite for its friends.

cards.name: Antlion Pit
cards.where: Win Komodo Wallow in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Step lightly over the empty ground. It is not empty.

cards.name: Leopard Seal
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It smiles at the penguins. The penguins do not smile back.

cards.name: Springbok Pronker
cards.where: Win Zebra Stampede in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: It bounces straight up when it sees a lion. It is very good at bouncing.

cards.name: Supernova Jelly
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: It glows brighter and brighter, and then everything else glows too.

cards.name: Geode Scorpion
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: When it dies it does not rot. It sparkles.

cards.name: Cleaner Wrasse
cards.where: Win Clownfish Shoal in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: It picks the poison out of the big fish, and they let it.

cards.name: Snow Leopard
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Avalanches, cliffs, blizzards: it has walked through all of them, quietly.

cards.name: Lovebird
cards.where: Win Hyena Chorus in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: One is a bird. Two is a promise.

cards.name: Horned Lizard
cards.where: Win Obsidian Nest in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: Corner it and it squirts blood from its eyes into yours.

cards.name: Dromedary
cards.where: Win Widow's Web in The Glass Dunes (Conquest)
cards.fl: It packed water for a week and patience for a month, and the desert has yet to outlast either.

cards.name: Marula Monkey
cards.where: Win Howler Canopy in Savanna Reaches (Conquest)
cards.fl: It shares the fermented fruit generously. Mostly by throwing it.

cards.name: Lyrebird Mimic
cards.where: Win Quillback Hold in The Briar Maze (Conquest)
cards.fl: It sounds like your captain. It sounds like your horn. It sounds like you.

cards.name: Chained Binturong
cards.where: Win Vent Skitter in Basalt Foundry (Conquest)
cards.fl: Somebody chained it for a reason. Somebody will regret the lock.

cards.name: Rimefire Salamander
cards.where: Win Steam Vents in The Rimefire Caldera (Conquest)
cards.fl: Born where a lava tube runs under a glacier. It breathes steam and has never once been comfortable.

cards.name: Fumarole Ibex
cards.where: Win Hailstone Ridge in The Rimefire Caldera (Conquest)
cards.fl: Warms its hooves on the vents, licks the salt off the sulphur, and climbs anything.

cards.name: Ashwing Ptarmigan
cards.where: Win Ashfall Cornice in The Rimefire Caldera (Conquest)
cards.fl: White in winter, brown in summer, and grey since the crater started coughing.

cards.name: Caldera Snow Leopard
cards.where: Win The Rimeheart Colossus in The Rimefire Caldera (Conquest)
cards.fl: It hunts the crater rim in the steam, where nothing can see it coming and nothing can hear it over the vents.

cards.name: Rimeheart Colossus
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Half glacier, half magma. Where it walks the snow boils and the lava freezes.

cards.name: War Elephant
cards.where: Win Marshal Tuskwell in The Goldfeather Siege (Conquest)
cards.fl: A walking tower with a howdah on top and two archers inside who never agree on a target.

cards.name: Howdah Archers
cards.where: Win The Elephant Line in The Goldfeather Siege (Conquest)
cards.fl: Two langurs, one bow each, and a running argument about whose turn it is to duck.

cards.name: Testudo Tortoise
cards.where: Win Trench Works in The Goldfeather Siege (Conquest)
cards.fl: Shell up, head in, and let the arrows rain. It has been rained on before.

cards.name: Trebuchet Crew
cards.where: Win Siege Camp in The Goldfeather Siege (Conquest)
cards.fl: Beavers know timber, and timber knows how to throw a rock over a wall.

cards.name: Marshal Tuskwell
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Forty sieges, forty wins, and a howdah with a little flag on it for each.

cards.name: Great Gate
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: Oak, iron, gold leaf, and a doorbell nobody has ever dared ring.

cards.name: Goose Sentry
cards.where: Win The Bailey in Goldfeather Keep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Nobody gets past the goose. Nobody has ever wanted to try twice.

cards.name: Mallard Halberdier
cards.where: Win The Gilded Guard in Goldfeather Keep (Conquest)
cards.fl: A long pole with a blade on the end, and a duck who knows exactly how long it is.

cards.name: Tax-Collector Teal
cards.where: Win The Counting House in Goldfeather Keep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every hit comes with a receipt.

cards.name: Battlement Heron
cards.where: Win The Battlements in Goldfeather Keep (Conquest)
cards.fl: It stands on one leg on the wall walk for hours, and then it does not miss.

cards.name: Gilded Swan Knight
cards.where: Win The Magnate Duck in Goldfeather Keep (Conquest)
cards.fl: Gold plate on white feathers. It is worth a fortune dead, and it knows it.

cards.name: The Magnate Duck
cards.where: Not obtainable yet
cards.fl: He owns the keep, the valley and the road you came in on. Every hit he lands, he invoices.

cards.name: Gallery Orb-Weaver
cards.where: Win Silk Gallery in The Mycelium Deep (Conquest)
cards.fl: It spins the gallery a new ceiling every night, and keeps whatever sticks to it.

cards.name: Cottonmouth Matriarch
cards.where: Win Adder Gauntlet in Sable Swampmire (Conquest)
cards.fl: She opens her white mouth once, as a warning. Her daughters skip that part.

cards.name: Hedgehog Herbalist
cards.where: Win The Grove Warden in The Sunken Grove (Conquest)
cards.fl: Pockets full of moss, mint and something nobody should eat raw.

cards.name: Eagle-Owl Quartermaster
cards.where: Win Summit Approach in Eyrie Heights (Conquest)
cards.fl: Every feather in the eyrie’s quivers passed through her talons first.

cards.name: Ossuary Lammergeier
cards.where: Win The Ash Ossuary in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: It drops the bones on the rocks until they crack, then eats what is inside. It is in no hurry.

cards.name: Walrus Icebreaker
cards.where: Win Glacier Herd in Wolfsbane Tundra (Conquest)
cards.fl: Two tusks, one tonne, and a firm belief that ice is only a suggestion.

cards.name: Sea Cucumber
cards.where: Win Tide Pool Line in Coral Current (Conquest)
cards.fl: Poke it and it throws its insides at you, sticky threads and all. A week later it has grown a new set and is back on the reef, chewing sand.

cards.name: Fathom Leviathan
cards.where: Raid only: The Goliath drops its cards when it falls (more for the top raiders)
cards.fl: Sailors call the first swell a storm. The second one has eyes.

cards.name: Grovebearer Dragon-Turtle
cards.where: Win Marshal Tuskwell in The Goldfeather Siege (Conquest)
cards.fl: There is a whole wood on its back, with a stream, two badger setts and a shrine. Nobody up there has noticed it walking.

cards.name: Ashmantle Fiend
cards.where: Win Heart of the Mountain in Eye of the Volcano (Conquest)
cards.fl: The Ashen Choir sang for something bigger. It came up out of the vent wearing the smoke like a cloak, and the singing stopped.

cards.name: Grotto Lobster
cards.where: Win The Glowing Pool in Smugglers' Grotto (Conquest)
cards.fl: Its brood scuttles out first. The claws come after.

cards.name: Amber Cicada
cards.where: Win Cricket Chorus in Thistlewood (Conquest)
cards.fl: Seven years under the roots, for one loud autumn in the branches.

cards.name: Sandfish
cards.where: Win Bleached Flats in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: It swims through the dunes the way a fish swims through water, and only comes up to bite.

cards.name: Pale Oryx
cards.where: Win Oryx Crossing in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: Bone-white on bone-white sand. You only see it once it lowers its horns.

cards.name: Quicksand Queen
cards.where: Win The Quicksand Queen in The Pale Desert (Conquest)
cards.fl: Her pit looks like solid ground. Everything that has walked on it agrees, briefly.
